title: Fabula Ultima Sprite Animator
description: 2D skeletal animation for character sprites. Rig any PNG or WebP sprite in the Sprite Animation Studio (bones, joints, bending parts, hidden-region fill), preview reusable animations (idle, sword slash, heavy slash, magic cast, hits) and let actors' tokens play them on the map. Pixel art stays pixel-exact. Works alongside Fabula Ultima Battle Animations.

recommends.reason: Battle effects, dashes and impacts; the sprite animator animates the characters themselves.
